label: Google Sheets: Lookup Rows
description: Find the rows where a column holds a value: resolve an id to its record, check whether a key is already logged. Needs a header row. Emits the matching rows, their sheet row numbers, and whether anything matched.

inputs.name: account
inputs.description: A Google account with write access to the sheet (the picker grant covers the file it picked).

inputs.name: spreadsheet
inputs.label: Spreadsheet
inputs.placeholder: Pick one, or paste its share link

inputs.name: tab
inputs.label: Tab
inputs.placeholder: Pick a tab, or paste a link with #gid=

inputs.name: column
inputs.label: Column
inputs.description: The header column to match on.

inputs.name: value
inputs.label: Value
inputs.description: The exact cell value to match.

outputs.name: rows
outputs.description: The matching rows, keyed by the header.

outputs.name: found
outputs.description: Whether at least one row matched.
